en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

en: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
u.src: 1  How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

p.src: 2  How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
u.src: 2  How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

p.src: 3  Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

en: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
u.src: 3  Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

p.src: 4  lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

en: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
u.src: 4  lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

p.src: 5  But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

en: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
u.src: 5  But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

p.src: 6  I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

en: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
u.src: 6  I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
